neighbours.label: The slot right before the name of a press outlet in an attribution or citation (London's Independent, tells The A.V. Club, interview with Game Front, Daily Nation)
fire: The minister gave a long interview to Kenya's Daily Nation about the drought.
Her essay first ran in Canada's Globe and Mail before it was reprinted abroad.
The singer tells The A.V. Club that the album took four years to finish.
In an interview with Rolling Stone, the drummer admitted the tour had nearly broken up the band.
The claim was repeated by Nigeria's Vanguard and by The Namibian a week later.
A columnist for Ireland's Irish Times called the budget a missed chance.
The study was first reported by New Scientist and later by The Guardian.
The coach told Sky Sports that the striker would miss the rest of the season.
quiet: The minister gave a long interview to Kenya's farmers about the drought.
Her essay first ran in Canada's largest cities before it was reprinted abroad.
The singer tells the audience that the album took four years to finish.
In an interview with his bandmates, the drummer admitted the tour had nearly broken up the band.
The claim was repeated by Nigeria's opposition and by the governor a week later.
A columnist for Ireland's farming lobby called the budget a missed chance.
The study was first reported by the authors and later by their rivals.
The coach told the players that the striker would miss the rest of the season.
